title: NodePatch
description: NodePatch describes a request to update an existing node

cpu_allocation_rate.description: Update the CPU allocation rate for the node

cpus.description: Update the number of CPUs for the node

gpu_encoder_slots.description: Update the number of GPU encoder slots to configure on the node

gpu_slots.description: Update the number of GPU slots to configure on the node

memory.description: Update the memory (in GB) for the node

memory_allocation_rate.description: Update the memory allocation rate for the node

public_address.description: Update the public IP Address of the node

subnet.description: Update the subnet info of the node if the subnet of a node is changed

tags.description: Update the tags of the node

unscheduable.description: DEPRECATED Flag in favour of `unschedulable` flag

unschedulable.description: Flag used to remove the node from scheduler and not schedule containers on it

encoder_slots.description: Update the number of GPU encoder slots

id.description: ID of the GPU configured on the node
